integrity: Proof establishes universal statements analytically. Finite exact-arithmetic and numerical checks are supplementary, not external verification.
scientific_limitations: One-generation independent sex assignment only; probability of any mating is not long-run extinction probability.
The mating function and its binomial expectation already appear in Bessa-Gomes et al. (2004); novelty claim concerns optimization and asymptotic classification, not the model formula.
The quantile identity is restricted to group sizes divisible by capacity plus one; the logarithmic reserve requires capacity at least n-1.
A closely related 2010 mating-function study was inaccessible in full and may contain additional equivalent observations.
title: Finite polygynous founder groups: a sharp sex-allocation tradeoff and logarithmic male reserves
